disclosure: Speed-to-lead statistics are widely cited in inside sales research (Lead Response Management study, Harvard Business Review, InsideSales.com) and are presented here as industry benchmarks, not Black Arrow's own measured data.

claims.text: The Lead Response Audit uses four inputs, monthly leads, close rate, average job value, and typical response time, to generate a response score and a lead-loss estimate, free with no signup
Industry benchmarks put average lead response time at over an hour for most service businesses
Leads contacted within 5 minutes close at meaningfully higher rates than those contacted later
